title: After Hextech Disc created its Mech token, the engine offered (and executed, for free) `equipCard {equipmentId: Hextech Disc, unitId: Mech token}` — attaching a plain Gear as if it were Equipment.
expected: equipment.ts:92-104 enumerator filters candidate sources only by `def.cardType !== "equipment" && def.cardType !== "gear"` (line 94), same controller, and `!meta.attachedTo` — there is no check for an [Equip] keyword, Equipment tag/subtype, or equip cost. The condition (line 145) repeats the same permissive gear-or-equipment check. Hextech Disc in packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/sets/ven.json is `cardType: "gear"`, `tags: []`, rulesText has no [Equip], so it passes the filter and is cross-producted with every controlled unit (lines 124-130), including its own Mech token; the reducer then sets attachedTo/equippedWith with no cost (comment at line 61 admits Equip cost is not charged).
observed: moves listed equipCard for player-1-main-999-ven-087-166 -> token-mech-*; executing it set Disc meta.attachedTo=token and token meta.equippedWith=[Disc] with no cost paid. Root cause: equipment.ts equipCard enumerator accepts def.cardType === "gear" as well as "equipment".
